content:
andre: Security advisory - automated scan found an AWS role `redwood-deployer` with a wide trust policy (Principal: "*") allowing external assume. This is high risk for prod accounts. We need to lock the trust policy and rotate any long-lived credentials that rely on this role.

sec-scan-bot: Finding RW-AWS-401: iam-role-open-trust detected in account: redwood-prod. Affected role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-deployer. See ticket RW-Sec-987.

mika: Ack. Is the immediate required action to patch the trust policy or to disable the role until we confirm owners?

andre: Short-term: add a deny for external principals and add Condition {StringEquals: sts:ExternalId: <expected>} if callers use external-id. Long-term: restrict to specific principal ARNs and implement session tagging. Plan: patch in a maintenance window tonight 23:00-00:00 UTC, owners test assume-role flows.

frank: I own deployer flows for infra. I'll take the role fix and run canary in non-prod. Please provide the safe assume-policy snippet.

andre: Example safe assume-policy (replace placeholders):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ci-runner"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "redwood-prod"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Use `aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name redwood-deployer --policy-document file://policy.json`.

infra-oncall: Scheduled temporary maintenance window: 2026-03-31 23:00-00:00 UTC. We'll monitor CloudTrail for failed assumes.

tina: Quick checklist for owners after patch: `owner: service - role: - action: patched/disabled - canary: success/fail - notes`

frank: owner: infra-deployer - role: redwood-deployer - action: patched - canary: success - notes: updated trust policy to restrict principal to CI role, added externalId check, verified assume-role from CI and service account.

andre: Also audit for any long-lived access keys or embedded creds that depend on this role. If you find any, rotate them and open RW-Sec-987 follow-up.

sec-scan-bot: Post-action re-scan scheduled in 2 hours. Will report any remaining wide-trust roles.

andre: Thanks team. We'll close the ticket once the re-scan reports clean and all owners post status here. If you did not get notified but own a role that assumes cross-account, please check your trust policies.
